warranty.title: 90-Day Service Warranty
body: Every listed refurbished appliance includes a 90-day RB Care service warranty from the delivery date for verified functional faults.
The warranty does not cover physical damage, misuse, water damage, insect damage, voltage fluctuation, consumables, cosmetic issues disclosed on the listing, or repairs performed by another provider.
To request service, share your order ID, contact number and a photo/video of the fault. Our team will arrange diagnosis and an appropriate repair, replacement, or refund remedy where applicable.

returns.title: Returns, Cancellations & Refunds
body: You may cancel an order before dispatch. Once delivery is completed, we do not accept change-of-mind returns because every pre-owned appliance is a unique inspected unit.
If the delivered product has a verified functional fault covered by the 90-day warranty, contact us promptly. We will diagnose it and provide the applicable warranty remedy.
Any approved refund is returned to the original payment method after the item and issue are verified.

delivery.title: Delivery & Installation
body: City-stock products are delivered only within their listed city: Lucknow, Mumbai, Pune, or Gonda. Central-stock products may be dispatched to supported cities after delivery feasibility is confirmed.
The exact delivery and installation charge is shown before payment. Our team contacts you after successful payment to arrange an available delivery slot.
Customers must provide accurate address, access and floor/lift details. Extra handling or installation work not shown in the order may require prior approval and an additional charge.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
body: We collect customer contact, delivery and order information only to process purchases, fulfil orders, provide warranty support and meet legal obligations.
Payment card and UPI credentials are processed by the selected payment gateway, not stored by RB Care Refurbished. We do not sell customer data.

terms.title: Terms of Sale
body: RB Care Refurbished Appliances is an independent seller of pre-owned appliances. We are not an authorised service centre or representative of appliance manufacturers.

Product descriptions disclose known condition at the time of listing. Photos are of the listed unit unless expressly stated otherwise. Product availability is confirmed only after successful payment verification.

items.q: Are the appliances tested before delivery?
items.a: Every unit passes a 40-point diagnostic — motor, compressor, cooling coils, electronics and finish. Nothing ships without a green light from our senior technician. We strip the appliance down, restore it, and stress-test it under load before listing.
We stock Godrej, Samsung, LG, Whirlpool, Voltas, Haier, IFB, Bosch, Panasonic and Bluestar across all categories including washing machines, ACs, refrigerators and microwaves.

items.q: Are these appliances genuine or assembled locally?
items.a: All appliances are genuine OEM units — original branded appliances that have been returned, traded in, or sourced from verified channels. We do not deal in assembled or counterfeit goods.

items.q: How old are the appliances typically?
items.a: Most units are 1–4 years old. Each product listing mentions the approximate age. You'll always know exactly what you're buying.
All appliances come with a 6-month parts and labour warranty from the date of delivery. You can extend this to 24 months at the time of checkout for a small additional fee.
The warranty covers verified functional faults — if a covered component fails under normal use, we fix or replace it at no cost. It does not cover physical damage, power surge damage, or misuse.

items.q: How do I claim warranty service?
items.a: WhatsApp us at 08503939715 with your order ID and a short video of the issue. A technician will be assigned within 24 hours for in-home repair.

items.q: Do you offer Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC)?
items.a: Yes! After your warranty expires, you can opt for our AMC which includes 2 free servicing visits per year and priority support. Contact us for pricing.
We currently deliver to Lucknow, Mumbai, Pune, and Gonda. Our technicians handle delivery and installation personally — we don't use third-party couriers for appliances.
Most orders are delivered within 2–5 business days depending on your city. Same-week delivery is available in Lucknow and Gonda in most cases.
Yes! Free installation by our certified RB Care technicians is included with every appliance. For ACs, we include installation up to a standard single-unit setup.

items.q: Can I inspect the appliance before accepting delivery?
items.a: Absolutely. Our delivery technician will demonstrate the appliance functioning before you sign off. You can refuse delivery if the unit doesn't match the listing description.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: We accept all major payment methods including UPI, credit/debit cards, net banking and EMI through Razorpay. We do not accept cash on delivery.
Completely. All payments are processed through Razorpay, a PCI-DSS compliant payment gateway. Your card details are never stored on our servers.

items.q: Can I cancel my order after placing it?
items.a: Yes, within 24 hours of placing your order. After that, the unit may already be prepped for delivery. Contact us via WhatsApp immediately if you need to cancel.
We accept returns within 7 days of delivery if the appliance has a verified functional defect that we cannot resolve. Cosmetic issues mentioned in the listing are not grounds for return.

items.q: Can I trade in my old appliance?
items.a: Yes! Contact us via WhatsApp or the bulk enquiry form. Our team will assess your old appliance remotely (via photos/video) and offer a trade-in value that you can use against your purchase.

items.q: Do you offer bulk pricing for businesses?
items.a: Yes. Hotels, hostels, offices, PG owners and landlords can contact us for bulk pricing on 10+ units. We offer significant discounts, priority delivery and extended warranties on bulk orders.
